verdict.rationale: A live probe found a working llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with agent-directed instructions. The Terminal docs are served as clean Markdown (terminal.md, HTTP 200), and Stripe documents agent-first developer tooling, including an MCP server that lets agents search its documentation. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt specifically indexes Terminal pages, and independent user reports of agents using these docs successfully.
